name: @devgateway/agent-runtime
description: Fixture-safe Python workflow runtime skeleton for DevGateway agents.

scripts.test:durable:chaos: node -e "if (!process.env.DATABASE_CHECK_URL && !process.env.AGENT_RUNTIME_POSTGRES_TEST_URL) { console.error('Track 3 chaos gate requires a disposable Postgres URL via DATABASE_CHECK_URL or AGENT_RUNTIME_POSTGRES_TEST_URL.'); process.exit(2); }" && python -m pytest tests/postgres_durability_test.py -q -k "in_progress_workflow_resumes_after_process_restart_without_restarting or lease_sweeper_recovers_pre_side_effect_and_escalates_running or outbox_claim_survives_crash_before_delivery or authorized_approved_approval_resumes_exactly_once"
scripts.transit: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from devgateway_agent_runtime.cli import main; raise SystemExit(main(['--mode', 'fixture', '--format', 'json']))"
